headline: Airport Manager's report, subcommittee updates, and a proposal to create an airport user survey.
summary: The meeting covers the Airport Manager's report on operations, budget, noise complaints, and PFAS tracking, along with updates from the Governance and Airport Mission subcommittees. Commissioner Doxsee will propose directing staff to create an airport user survey, and Chairman Retallack will discuss the structure of Airport Commission subcommittees.
items: General Public Comment (3 minutes per speaker; 15 minutes max)
Presentation by Airport Solutions Group - Craig Schuster

Airport Manager's Report by Gabriel Hanafin, including operations and fee report, year-to-date budget summary, noise complaints received since September 14, 2026, update on petroleum and PFAS release tracking at BVY, update on tree clearing on airport property, discussion on video recording of Airport Commission Meetings, upcoming Fly-by 5K and Fun-run (10/18/2026), and update on EAA Young Eagles Rally planned for September 26th
Update from the Chair of the Governance Subcommittee
Update from the Chair of the Mission Statement Subcommittee and presentation of proposed Airport Mission Statement
Commissioner Doxsee's proposal to direct the Airport Manager and staff to create and disseminate an airport user survey
Chairman Retallack's discussion on the structure, number, and nature of Airport Commission subcommittees
location: Beverly Regional Airport Conference Room, 50 L. P. Henderson Road, Beverly, MA 01915
